verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports memory expiration (expiration_date) which lets old facts stop surfacing once outdated, and graph memory links entities across memories, giving partial temporal/state-tracking capability. However there is no documented explicit 'valid_from/valid_until' fact validity tracking or fact-invalidation-on-contradiction mechanism comparable to true temporal reasoning. missing for 10: explicit temporal validity fields (valid_from/invalid_at) on facts, documented contradiction/invalidation-on-update logic, and independent verification that outdated facts are distinguished from current ones beyond simple expiration dates.
